subject: Banking & remittance preferences for Redwood vendor set up - Blue Harbor
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.inference>
To: Alicia Reynolds <alicia.reynolds@blueharbor.io>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.inference>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference>
Date: Mon, 11 May 2026 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Banking & remittance preferences for Redwood vendor set up - Blue Harbor

Hi Alicia —

Thanks for agreeing to get Blue Harbor set up in our system. To finish procurement + finance onboarding we need a couple of quick confirmations so our AP team can route invoices and pay on time. Can you send the items below (attaching our vendor onboarding form as well):

- Preferred payment method: ACH or wire? If ACH, please provide routing + account number and account name exactly as it appears on the bank account. If you accept wire, please include the full wire instructions (beneficiary name, bank name, SWIFT/BIC, IBAN if applicable).
- Remittance email: which email should we send remittance notices to? (example: invoices@blueharbor.io)
- Invoice submission: do you prefer PDF invoices by email, a vendor portal, or an EDI/e-invoicing integration? If email, please confirm the address and whether we should put the PO number in the subject line.
- Payment terms: confirm your standard terms (NET30, NET45, etc.) and whether earlier payment discounts are available.
- Required docs: please return the attached vendor onboarding form, W-9 (or equivalent), and any bank letter if you require wire verification for large transfers.

Notes from our side: Redwood requires a PO number on every invoice for payment. Our default payment term is NET30 unless otherwise agreed and approved by finance. For wires above $100k we ask for a recent bank letter or voided check for validation.

If you can get these back by end of week we can schedule the vendor record creation and issue the first PO.

Appended: Vendor_Onboarding_Form.pdf (please fill and sign)

Thanks —
Soji (Sooin) Lee
Procurement Manager | Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.inference | +1 (415) 555-0192

Attachment: BlueHarbor_Vendor_Form.pdf

From: Alicia Reynolds <alicia.reynolds@blueharbor.io>

Date: Mon, 11 May 2026 11:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Banking & remittance preferences for Redwood vendor set up - Blue Harbor

Hi Soojin —

Appreciate the checklist. Quick answers below and I attached our signed onboarding form and W-9. Bank details are included in the attached PDF.

- Preferred payment method: ACH is preferred. ACH details are included in BlueHarbor_bank_details.pdf (routing, account number, account name).
- Wire: we can accept wires as a fallback. Wire instructions (beneficiary, bank, SWIFT) are on the same PDF.
- Remittance email: invoices@blueharbor.io — please send remittance notices there. We monitor that inbox and it feeds our AP system.
- Invoice submission: PDF invoices via email are fine for us. Please include the Redwood PO number in the email subject line as: "PO <number> - Blue Harbor".
- Payment terms: Standard is NET30. We do not offer early payment discounts currently.

Attachments: BlueHarbor_Vendor_Form_filled.pdf, BlueHarbor_W9.pdf, BlueHarbor_bank_details.pdf

Let me know if you need a bank letter for wire verification for larger transfers — we can provide one from our bank.

Best,
Alicia Reynolds
Head of Finance Operations | Blue Harbor Analytics
